# Publish scheduler (community, Node only)

Authors set **publish at** and **unpublish at** times on a page (`publishSchedulerSet`). They are stored in the page itself under `metadata.plugins.publish-scheduler`, declared in `config/entities.yaml`, so they travel with the site and core drops anything undeclared there. The `publish` schedule (every 15 minutes) flips `metadata.published` for every page that is due. Core runs the job as one bulk transaction, so git makes a single commit for the batch.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| operation | `publishSchedulerSet` | `PUT /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/pages/{pageId}` (bearerAuth) | Sets or clears a page's publishAt and unpublishAt times, stored in metadata.plugins.publish-scheduler. |
| operation | `publishSchedulerDue` | `GET /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/due` (bearerAuth) | Lists the pages that have a publish or unpublish time set. |
| schedule | `publish` | `*/15 * * * *` | Publishes and unpublishes the pages whose times have passed, every 15 minutes. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
